aboutPreview.label: Who We Are
aboutPreview.text: iGate Interiors is a Kuwait-based design and fit-out firm creating modernized spaces for Retail, F&B, Commercial, and Industrial sectors. From shell & core through to final handover — we handle every trade.
aboutPreview.founder: Founded by Mr. Anthony Cardin and expanded under Mr. Sabiullah Siraj, iGate has grown into a major establishment delivering turn-key execution across Kuwait.
aboutPreview.missionText: Advancing professionalism, integrity, and efficiency in every space.
aboutPreview.philosophyText: Design should be seamless, practical, and inspiring from start to finish.

expertise.label: What We Do
expertise.subtitle: From shell & core through to final handover — we handle every trade, every detail.
expertise.fitoutDesc: Complete turn-key contracting from shell & core to final handover. We manage the complexity so you can focus on the result.
expertise.designDesc: Conceptualizing functional layouts that optimize flow. We transform specific requirements into realized environments.
expertise.mepDesc: HVAC, Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing. Certified installation, maintenance, and compliance.
expertise.joineryDesc: Bespoke woodworks from our specialized facility. From traditional craftsmanship to modern design execution.

projects.label: Our Work
projects.heroSub: 30+ completed projects across Kuwait — from retail flagships and restaurants to warehouses and executive offices.

process.label: How We Work
process.step1Desc: We understand your vision, budget, timeline, and specific requirements. Every project begins with listening.
process.step2Desc: 2D/3D renderings and material boards. You approve the finished space before construction begins.
process.step3Desc: MEP, civil, joinery, and finishes — executed with daily progress updates and strict quality control.
process.step4Desc: Final walkthrough, snag list clearance, and formal handover. We stay available post-completion.
